key_point: Why every TF2 map got a saluting statue
title: Why every TF2 map got a saluting statue
caption: Valve added saluting statues to Team Fortress 2 to honor Rick May, the voice of the Soldier. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #tf2 #teamfortress2

instagram.caption:
Rick May voiced the loud, beloved Soldier in Team Fortress 2. He passed away in April 2020.

Valve added bronze statues of the Soldier saluting to most official maps, with a plaque that says: That was a hell of a campaign, son!

Players lined up to salute. The statues return every year, and a permanent one stands on Granary.

Did you ever salute one?
